mainEntity.name: Can I charge a late fee on any invoice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if your contract or invoice terms say so, or a law gives you the right, such as the UK and EU late payment rules for business-to-business debts.
Many businesses use 1% to 1.5% a month (12% to 18% a year) if their terms allow it. Some places cap the rate, and statutory rates differ.
A number of days after the due date during which no interest or fee is charged. It is set in your terms.
Simple interest is charged on the original amount only and is the norm for invoices. Compound interest adds unpaid interest to the balance.

mainEntity.name: Is the day the invoice is paid included?

acceptedAnswer.text: This counts the days between the due date and the date you choose, not including the due date itself.
